questions.question_text: Why are antibiotics ineffective against the common cold?
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Common cold is caused by viruses. Antibiotics specifically target bacterial cellular structures (like cell walls) and are ineffective against viral entities.

questions.question_text: Explain why community sanitation is directly linked to personal health.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Pathogens and vectors thrive in unsanitary public environments (open garbage, blocked drains). Unsanitary surroundings pollute air, water, and food supplies, infecting individuals regardless of personal hygiene.

questions.question_text: Detail the holistic pillars required to maintain optimal health according to WHO and traditional health systems.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: 1. Balanced Nutrition: Consuming adequate carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, and roughage. 2. Hygiene & Sanitation: Personal cleanliness and vector-free surroundings. 3. Physical Exercise: Regular activity strengthening cardiovascular and muscular systems. 4. Vaccination: Timely immunization against communicable diseases. 5. Mental Well-being & Rest: Adequate sleep, stress control, and positive social connections.
